finding: IANA distinguishes Beijing time (Asia/Shanghai) from Xinjiang time (Asia/Urumqi); a city alone cannot determine which clock a birth record used.
implementation: GeoNames raw IANA field unchanged. Only cities whose catalog zone is Asia/Urumqi show a required record-clock choice (Beijing/Xinjiang), no raw time zone or coordinates fields. Choice determines normalized timezone; archive includes both catalogTimeZone and selected clockBasis. Missing choice never assumes either convention. Other cities automatically use catalog IANA rules; source historical uncertainty remains.
